description: This file implements an immutable class called ImmutableLogicalFilter, which provides logical combination operations (AND, OR, NOT) for search filters within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It allows creation of complex search filter expressions by combining simpler search filters with logical operators.

classes.name: ImmutableLogicalFilter
classes.description: An immutable implementation of LogicalSearchFilter that supports creating logical filter expressions with AND, OR, and NOT operators.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Creates a NOT logical filter wrapping the given SearchFilter.

methods.name: and
methods.description: Creates an AND logical filter combining multiple SearchFilters.

methods.name: or
methods.description: Creates an OR logical filter combining multiple SearchFilters.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of logical filter (AND, OR, NOT).

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Returns the collection of SearchFilters that are combined in this logical filter.
